entities.summary: Ian Theodore Anderson is an American professional baseball pitcher who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves and Los Angeles Angels. Anderson was selected out of high school by the Braves with the third overall pick of the 2016 MLB draft, and made his MLB debut in 2020. Anderson won a World Series ring in 2021 as a member of the Braves.
